title: Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
title_zh: LLM智能体能担任前置部署工程师吗？面向企业级Text-to-SQL的需求发现与交付

paragraphs.en: LLM coding agents can increasingly automate model post-training, but whether they can act as forward-deployed engineer (FDE) agents, discovering customer requirements and turning them into deployment decisions, remains unclear. We study this on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement: a simulated customer, grounded in the real use case’s requirements, starts with an ambiguous request. An agent must discover acceptance criteria, data permissions, and hardware constraints in the discovery phase, then plan and execute a post-training recipe in the delivery phase. Across 15 models, the strongest discover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models discover 40-50%; in the delivery phase, only 25% of runs across eight coding-agent configurations pass all acceptance criteria. We identify four bottlenecks in this engagement: (1) incomplete discovery, with 40% of withheld requirements missing or misrepresented; (2) unreliable execution; (3) underused compute budgets and a lack of systematic comparisons across base models and post-training methods; and (4) benchmark accuracy does not guarantee production readiness. We suggest human review of discovered requirements, monitoring of the agent’s plan during execution, and an explicit experiment-environment specification covering hardware, budget scope, and production checks.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 编程智能体日益能够自动化模型后训练，但它们能否充当前置部署工程师（FDE）智能体——即发现客户需求并将其转化为部署决策——仍不清楚。 我们在一个真实的企业级 text-to-SQL 项目上研究这一问题：一个基于真实用例需求构建的模拟客户，从一个模糊的请求开始。 智能体必须在发现阶段探索出验收标准、数据权限和硬件约束，然后在交付阶段规划并执行后训练方案。 在 15 个模型中，最强的模型能发现超过 80% 的隐藏需求，开源权重模型能发现 40-50%；在交付阶段，八种编程智能体配置中只有 25% 的运行通过了全部验收标准。 我们在这一项目中识别出四个瓶颈：(1) 发现不完整，40% 的隐藏需求缺失或被错误表述；(2) 执行不可靠；(3) 计算预算未充分利用，且缺乏在不同基座模型和后训练方法之间的系统性比较；(4) 基准测试的准确率并不能保证生产可用性。 我们建议对发现的需求进行人工审核，在执行过程中监控智能体的计划，并制定一份明确的实验环境规范，涵盖硬件、预算范围和生产检查。

paragraphs.en: Turning a capable language model into a useful enterprise system requires understanding customer workflows, identifying operational constraints, and making engineering decisions that connect model behavior to business needs. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) perform this work by embedding with customer teams and taking responsibility for discovery, technical design, implementation, and delivery ( Vartabedian and Chernova, 2025 ) . Pioneered at Palantir, the role combines hands-on engineering with the judgment needed to turn an initially incomplete business problem into a working solution.
paragraphs.zh: 要把一个能力强大的语言模型转变为有用的企业系统，需要理解客户工作流程、识别运营约束，并做出将模型行为与业务需求相连接的工程决策。 前置部署工程师（FDE）通过嵌入客户团队并承担需求调研、技术设计、实现与交付的职责来完成这项工作（Vartabedian and Chernova, 2025）。 这一角色由 Palantir 开创，它将一线工程实践与判断力相结合，把最初不完整的业务问题转化为可运行的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: To investigate these questions, we study a production use case of forward-deployed engineering for enterprise text-to-SQL, grounded in a completed engagement: a human forward deployment engineer’s delivery of a commercial text-to-SQL system to an internal stakeholder, including its requirement discussions, experiment log, and shipped model. From this record, we annotate the customer’s stated requirements and the operational facts into standardized customer knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究这些问题，我们以一个已完成的项目为基础，研究企业级文本转 SQL 前置部署工程的生产用例：由一名人类前置部署工程师向内部利益相关方交付一套商用的文本转 SQL 系统，包括其需求讨论、实验日志和已交付的模型。 基于这一记录，我们将客户明确提出的需求与运营事实标注为标准化的客户知识。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , our FDE agent delivers the solution in two phases: discovery and delivery. In the discovery phase, the simulated customer begins with an ambiguous request, and the FDE agent must ask follow-up questions to clarify the requirements. The simulated customer answers the FDE agent’s follow-up questions using annotated customer knowledge derived from the ground-truth engagement. Finally, the FDE agent consolidates the information gathered into a set of discovered requirements. In the delivery phase, the FDE agent can either plan and execute the solution end-to-end or separate planning from execution. It first takes the requirements gathered during discovery and the available data to produce a detailed plan covering model baselining, post-training, evaluation, profiling and checkpoint selection. Finally, it refines and executes the plan until the goal is achieved.
paragraphs.zh: 如图1所示，我们的FDE智能体分两个阶段提供解决方案：发现阶段和交付阶段。 在发现阶段，模拟客户首先提出一个模糊的请求，FDE智能体必须通过追问来澄清需求。 模拟客户使用源自真实客户互动的标注客户知识来回答FDE智能体的追问。 最后，FDE智能体将收集到的信息整合为一组已发现的需求。 在交付阶段，FDE智能体既可以端到端地规划和执行解决方案，也可以将规划与执行分开。 它首先利用发现阶段收集的需求和可用数据，制定一份涵盖模型基线、训练后处理、评估、性能分析和检查点选择的详细计划。 最后，它会不断细化和执行该计划，直至达成目标。

paragraphs.en: Our contribution is a deployment case study of FDE agents in a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement that (1) uses annotated customer requirements to ground a customer simulator and the human FDE’s shipped system as a delivery baseline; (2) evaluates requirement discovery across 15 LLM agents from seven model families, measuring requirement discovery, elicitation through dialogue, and question cost; and (3) compares autonomous (end-to-end) and decoupled delivery workflows across four models, identifying bottlenecks, failure cases, and required human interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献是在一个真实的企业级 text-to-SQL 项目中对 FDE 智能体进行了部署案例研究，该研究：(1) 使用标注的客户需求来为客户模拟器和人类 FDE 的已交付系统作为交付基线提供依据；(2) 评估了来自七个模型系列的 15 个 LLM 智能体的需求发现能力，衡量需求发现、通过对话进行的需求引导以及提问成本；以及 (3) 比较了四个模型上的自主（端到端）与解耦交付工作流，识别瓶颈、失败案例以及所需的人工干预。

paragraphs.en: Ding and Zhan (2026) compare agent and human-plus-assistant delivery of post-training services across ten oracle-scored stages from ticket to deployment under shared ground truth; FDE-Bench ( Ding et al., 2026 ) and DeployBench ( Wang et al., 2026 ) also evaluate deployment. All of these studies begin with gathered requirements indicated in written tickets. We begin before ticket creation: the agent defines acceptance criteria and operational constraints through dialogue and experiments to establish facts unknown to customers. Our reference is a completed enterprise engagement with a human trajectory and a model serving in production, rather than a synthetic scenario on public datasets. Our fact-sheet based discovery simulation design could be generalized into other enterprise use cases.
paragraphs.zh: Ding 与 Zhan（2026）在共享真实基准下，比较了智能体与「人类加助手」在从工单到部署的十个以 oracle 评分阶段上交付后训练服务的情况；FDE-Bench（Ding 等，2026）与 DeployBench（Wang 等，2026）也对部署进行了评估。 所有这些研究都从书面工单中表明的已收集需求出发。 我们从工单创建之前开始：智能体通过对话和实验来定义验收标准与运维约束，以确立客户所未知的事实。 我们的参照是一次已完成的企业项目交付，包含人类轨迹与一个已在生产环境中服务的模型，而非公开数据集上的合成场景。 我们基于事实表（fact-sheet）的发现式模拟设计可以推广到其他企业用例。

paragraphs.en: A 2026 line of benchmarks asks whether agents can post-train models autonomously, including PostTrainBench ( Rank et al., 2026 ) , Agent 2 RL-Bench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , FT-Dojo ( Li et al., 2026 ) , continuing earlier ML-engineering evaluations such as MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , MLAgentBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , and RE-Bench ( Wijk et al., 2024 ) . Each supplies a complete task specification and rewards raising a held-out metric. We treat post-training as one stage of a delivery whose acceptance criteria are the customer’s. On top of that, our work involves iterative requirement gathering, technical solution discovery given the practical constraint before autonomous post-training efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 2026 年的一系列基准测试旨在探究智能体能否自主地对模型进行后训练，包括 PostTrainBench（Rank et al., 2026）、Agent 2 RL-Bench（Chen et al., 2026）、FT-Dojo（Li et al., 2026），延续了此前的机器学习工程评测，如 MLE-bench（Chan et al., 2025）、MLAgentBench（Huang et al., 2023）和 RE-Bench（Wijk et al., 2024）。 每个基准都提供完整的任务规范，并以提升留出集上的指标作为奖励。 我们将后训练视为交付流程中的一个阶段，其验收标准由客户决定。 在此基础上，我们的工作还涉及在自主后训练工作之前，根据实际约束进行迭代式需求收集和技术方案探索。

paragraphs.en: AmbigSWE ( Vijayvargiya et al., 2026 ) evaluates clarifying questions over an incomplete specification; Dialogue-SWEBench ( King and Flanigan, 2026 ) removes the specification entirely and evaluates coding agents through dialogue with a persona-grounded, self-revising user simulator; τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ) evaluates tool-use agents against simulated users under domain policies. We adopt user simulation but shift the focus from clarifying code changes to establishing deployment acceptance criteria and operational constraints, including those the customer cannot directly resolve and the agent must determine experimentally.
paragraphs.zh: AmbigSWE（Vijayvargiya et al., 2026）评估针对不完整规格说明的澄清式提问；Dialogue-SWEBench（King and Flanigan, 2026）则完全去除规格说明，通过与基于人设、可自我修正的用户模拟器对话来评估编码智能体；τ \tau -bench（Yao et al., 2025）在领域政策约束下对照模拟用户评估工具使用型智能体。 我们采用了用户模拟，但将重点从澄清代码变更转向确立部署验收标准与运维约束，包括那些客户无法直接解决、而必须由智能体通过实验来确定的内容。

paragraphs.en: Spider, BIRD, and Spider 2.0 track Text-to-SQL progress ( Yu et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Lei et al., 2025 ) , with execution-grounded post-training driving recent gains ( Zhai et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) ; SOMA-SQL ( Somayajula et al., 2026 ) tackles query and schema-level ambiguity through synthetic logs and execution probing; PLSQLBench extends executable evaluation to Oracle PL/SQL ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . We choose this domain for its concrete production constraints and executable evaluation.

paragraphs.en: We study forward deployment as two phases: discovery, in which an FDE agent turns an incomplete customer brief into requirements, and delivery, in which the requirements are turned into a post-trained, served system. Both phases are grounded in a completed engagement.

paragraphs.en: Our reference is a four-month deployment of an Oracle-dialect text-to-SQL model by one human FDE to a production stakeholder inside a large enterprise, recorded as established requirements, 100+ LoRA adapters and 200 evaluations, and the shipped Ministral-3 8B system with a scaled standalone adapter and engineered prompt. We use this record to ground the customer’s knowledge and the deployment constraints and baseline the FDE agent’s performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的参照对象是一个为期四个月的部署案例：由一名人类现场部署工程师（FDE）在大型企业内向生产环境利益相关方部署一个 Oracle 方言的文本转 SQL 模型，该案例记录了既定需求、100 多个 LoRA 适配器和 200 次评估，以及最终交付的 Ministral-3 8B 系统（配备经规模化整合的独立适配器和经过工程化设计的提示词）。 我们利用这一记录来锚定客户知识与部署约束，并作为该智能体（FDE 智能体）性能表现的基准。

paragraphs.en: Real customers rarely arrive with complete requirements. To mirror this, we annotate 17 core business, data, and evaluation requirements from the reference engagement, plus six decisions the customer had explicitly left open, such as the latency timing boundary (Appendix B ). An agent should elicit the 17 requirements and record the six decisions as open rather than guessing. This human-validated specification grounds the simulated customer and is the ground truth for discovery evaluation. The agent receives an ambiguous customer opening and must elicit requirements through dialogue; we test openings at low, moderate, and extreme ambiguity (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 真实客户很少带着完整的需求到来。 为了模拟这一点，我们从参考项目中标注了 17 项核心业务、数据和评估需求，以及客户明确留置未决的六项决策，例如延迟时序边界（附录 B）。 智能体应引导引出这 17 项需求，并将六项决策记录为待定项，而不是擅自猜测。 这份经人工验证的规格说明为模拟客户提供了依据，也是需求发现评估的真值基准。 智能体会收到一段含糊的客户开场白，必须通过对话引导引出需求；我们测试了低、中、高三种模糊程度的开场白（附录 A）。

In the autonomous workflow, a single coding agent plans and executes within one session.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate discovery using recovery rate, elicitation count, and ask turns. To compute them, Gemini 2.5 Flash first acts as an LLM judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , labeling each withheld fact as consistently captured in the submitted requirements and as disclosed through customer dialogue, against the human-validated fact sheet. Recovery rate is the fraction of withheld facts correctly submitted; elicitation count is the number of withheld facts both disclosed in dialogue and correctly submitted; ask turns counts clarification actions, each of which may bundle several questions. A human audit of discovery results from 3 models agrees with the LLM judge on 70.6% of recovery and 82.4% of disclosure labels (Appendix C ), providing support for the annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用恢复率、引导出数量和询问轮次来评估发现效果。 为计算这些指标，Gemini 2.5 Flash 首先充当 LLM 评判者（Zheng et al., 2023），对照经人工验证的事实清单，将每个保留事实标注为「在提交的需求中被一致捕获」以及「已通过客户对话披露」。 恢复率是正确提交的保留事实所占的比例；引导出数量是既在对话中披露又被正确提交的保留事实的数量；询问轮次统计澄清操作的次数，每次操作可能包含多个问题。 对 3 个模型的发现结果进行的人工审计与 LLM 评判者在恢复标签上有 70.6%、在披露标签上有 82.4% 的一致率（附录 C），为这些标注提供了支持。

paragraphs.en: In the extreme-ambiguity GPT-5.6 Sol trajectory, the agent raised questions the customer had never specified: which Oracle-SQL operation defines a successful compilation, what database privileges the system needs, where the latency timer starts and stops, and which evaluation protocol is acceptable. The customer acknowledges the ambiguity, and the agent recorded them as undecided. This mirrors real engagements, where customers often cannot answer until they see results: the FDE records the ambiguity, proceeds with a best guess, and, if the delivered numbers disappoint, traces back to the open decision and realigns with the customer (see Appendix D ).

paragraphs.en: Requirement discovery is incomplete, and what is discovered is not always handed over. Across 15 models and 10 runs (Table 7 ), agents recover 4,227 of 7,050 withheld facts (60.0%), leaving 40% missing or misrepresented. paragraphs.en: GPU budget management is poorly coordinated across planning, execution, and evaluation. We observed two types of budget-management failures. First, the agent underutilizes the available budget: given 12 hours of GPU time for post-training, the planner schedules 10 hours of experiments, but the actual execution takes less than 5 hours. The remainder is left idle rather than spent on the comparisons (Appendix G.3 ). Second, the pipeline misinterprets the scope of the budget: in the GLM Decoupled experiments, the GPU runner applied the 12-hour post-training limit to final inference, causing the executor to skip BIRD evaluation after saving the checkpoint (Appendix G.1 ).

paragraphs.en: We study whether LLM agents can act as forward-deployed engineers on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement, introducing an evaluation grounded in human-validated requirements and a shipped system. Across 15 models, the strongest recover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models about half, but only 25% of delivery runs satisfy all three acceptance criteria. Four bottlenecks emerge: incomplete requirement discovery, unreliable autonomous execution, underused compute with limited comparisons, and a benchmark-to-production gap. We recommend human review of requirements and plan, and explicit specifications for hardware, budgets, and production checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究 LLM 智能体能否在一个真实企业级 text-to-SQL 项目中担任前线部署工程师，并基于经过人工验证的需求与已交付上线的系统提出一套评估方法。 在 15 个模型中，最强的模型能恢复超过 80% 的保留需求，开放权重模型约为一半，但只有 25% 的交付运行满足全部三项验收标准。 研究发现四个瓶颈：需求发现不完整、自主执行不可靠、算力利用不足且对比有限，以及基准测试与生产环境之间的差距。 我们建议对需求和计划进行人工审查，并为硬件、预算和生产检查制定明确的规范。

paragraphs.en: The annotation fact set contains 17 known core facts derived from the delivered engagements, comprising 15 hard requirements and two preferences. Six explicitly unresolved questions are excluded from recovery denominators. Low, moderate, and extreme openings withhold 14, 16, and 17 core facts, respectively. Low-ambiguity openings state accuracy and latency targets and a conditional CPU preference; moderate openings retain the CPU preference; extreme openings convey the broad task. Detailed measurement conditions remain subjects for clarification. These labels denote initial information availability, not an independently validated difficulty scale. All known facts remain available to the simulator throughout the dialogue. Candidate replies are checked against the private specification and revised when inconsistent, adapting the validation-and-revision approach of King and Flanigan (2026) .

paragraphs.en: On each ask action, Gemini 2.5 Pro receives all currently available customer knowledge, the customer–engineer dialogue history, and the latest question, and generates a candidate reply. Questions determine relevance, not which facts the model is allowed to know. Replies should answer known requested details naturally, preserve unknowns, avoid unrelated requirement dumps, and distinguish engineering proposals from customer agreement. There is no persona sampling. The customer has dialogue access only: it cannot run code, inspect repository files, evaluate a model, or claim engineering results. Files are offered by permitted identifiers and released separately through the artifact actions.

paragraphs.en: Gemini 2.5 Flash reviews the candidate for grounding and disclosure violations and annotates question-target and disclosed-fact IDs. These diagnostic labels do not filter the generation knowledge. The implementation also checks for private annotation markers and certain unavailable-answer/file-block disclosures. A flagged candidate receives one targeted rewrite by Gemini 2.5 Pro and one further review. A remaining blocking violation yields a fixed fallback with no newly credited fact disclosure. Incompleteness, concision, character, and immersion flags alone are non-blocking after revision; an accurate but incomplete reply is retained with its flags. Malformed factual-review output invalidates the trajectory rather than being shown as customer uncertainty. Invalid diagnostic labels receive one labels-only repair; failure of that repair also invalidates the trajectory. Only the delivered final reply is returned to the agent; drafts, review labels, generation-source metadata, and reviewer identities remain in researcher logs.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 2.5 Flash 审查候选回复是否存在依据（grounding）与信息披露违规，并标注问题目标和已披露事实的 ID。 这些诊断标签不会过滤生成知识。 该实现还会检查私有标注标记以及某些不可用答案/文件屏蔽类披露。 被标记的候选回复会由 Gemini 2.5 Pro 进行一次针对性重写，并再做一次审查。 若仍存在阻断性违规，则返回固定的后备回复，且不新增任何事实披露的计入。 不完整、简洁性、性格与沉浸感标记在修订后单独出现时不构成阻断；准确但不完整的回复会连同其标记一并保留。 事实审查输出格式错误时，整个轨迹作废，而不是将其显示为客服的不确定性。 无效的诊断标签会进行一次仅针对标签的修复；若修复失败，轨迹同样作废。 只有最终交付的回复会返回给智能体；草稿、审查标签、生成来源元数据以及审查者身份仅保留在研究者日志中。

paragraphs.en: At conversation turn, the harness outputs one final action block: ask , request , inspect , or submit . The prompt requests exactly one final block; the parser selects the last action block and requires it to terminate the response. Questions outside the dispatched ask payload are not independently delivered. The limits are 28 outer turns and 15 initial ask actions, not 15 individual interrogative sentences; an ask action can bundle related questions. The current runner stops on submission and does not use the configured reserve-question or delivery-feedback hooks for a second discovery round.
paragraphs.zh: 在每轮对话中，运行框架输出一个最终动作块：ask、request、inspect 或 submit。 提示词要求恰好一个最终块；解析器选取最后一个动作块，并要求它作为响应的结尾。 分发的 ask 载荷之外的问题不会被独立送达。 上限是 28 个外层轮次和 15 个初始 ask 动作，而不是 15 个单独的疑问句；一个 ask 动作可以捆绑相关问题。 当前的运行器在提交时停止，不会使用配置的预留提问或送达反馈钩子进行第二轮探索。

paragraphs.en: At submission, Gemini 2.5 Flash compares each logical submitted line against currently available customer facts. The program renders Confirm for supported comparisons with no unsupported substantive content; Correct when a line contradicts a known fact, returning the annotated answer and acceptance details; and Can’t Say otherwise. An explicit acknowledgment of an annotated unknown can be consistent, whereas inventing its value is unsupported. A contradiction anywhere in the submission removes that fact from pre-readback coverage, even if another line states it correctly. The loop ends without post-readback agent repair. The handoff records corrections as superseding corresponding submitted claims and preserves unresolved decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，Gemini 2.5 Flash 将每个逻辑提交行与当前可用的客户事实进行比对。 对于支持且无不支持的实质内容的比对，程序呈现 Confirm（确认）；当某行与已知事实矛盾时，呈现 Correct（纠正），并返回标注后的答案与接受详情；否则呈现 Can't Say（无法判断）。 对标注的未知项作出明确承认可以是一致的，而编造其值则是不受支持的。 提交中任何位置的矛盾都会将该事实从预回读覆盖范围中移除，即使另一行正确陈述了它。 该循环在不进行回读后智能体修复的情况下结束。 交接记录将纠正记录为取代相应的提交主张，并保留未解决的决策。

Recovery measures core-fact coverage, not satisfaction of every clause in a compound requirement. Unknown facts receive no credit and are excluded from denominators; partial credit is not used. paragraphs.en: Availability to the simulator is distinct from disclosure to the agent. In the current fact sheet, all 23 annotations have availability at_start and channel ask . The simulator therefore has access to every known answer from the start, together with explicit statements of what remains undecided. The opening profile controls which core facts appear in the initial message; it does not remove knowledge from the customer or impose a turn-based release schedule. A correctly inferred but undisclosed fact receives recovery credit only; a disclosed fact that is omitted or contradicted in the submission receives no elicitation credit. Discarded customer drafts and readback corrections are evidence for neither label. The scorer checks C ⊆ W C\subseteq W , A ⊆ W A\subseteq W , and E = C ∩ A E=C\cap A , collapses duplicate fact IDs, and marks trajectories without a valid withheld denominator as unscorable rather than zero.

paragraphs.en: Table 7 pools all 450 trajectories across the 15-model cohort: ten recorded runs per model at each of three ambiguity levels. Each trajectory contains 14, 16, or 17 withheld facts at low, moderate, or extreme ambiguity, respectively, yielding 7,050 fact instances. The overall pooled recovery rate weights ambiguity levels by their withheld-fact counts, whereas an unweighted mean gives each level equal weight. Recovery increases from 56.3% to 59.8% to 63.2% across the three levels. Mean ask turns are 3.94, 3.93, and 4.74, respectively, with more questioning concentrated at extreme ambiguity. These pooled results are descriptive; they combine historical and newer runs with some differences in opening wording and deployment routes.

paragraphs.en: We audited one extreme-ambiguity trajectory for each of GPT-5.6 Sol, GLM-5.3-Flash, and Llama 3.3 70B, all 17 scored facts per trajectory (51 cases). The reviewer made the same two binary decisions per fact from the frozen fact sheet, delivered customer replies, and pre-readback submission. Table 8 compares the audit with the saved Gemini labels. Pooled agreement is 70.6% on C C and 82.4% on A A ; disclosure is easier to judge because it is anchored to a specific reply. The judge’s errors are not neutral across models: it credits GLM-5.3-Flash and Llama 3.3 70B with more recovered facts than the human (11 vs. 9 and 11 vs. 8) and GPT-5.6 Sol with fewer (13 vs. 15), so the frontier–open-weight gap in Table 1 is, if anything, understated. This audit is a calibration sample and should not be extrapolated to all 7,050 instances; fact-level review records are released with the code.

paragraphs.en: The later delivery execution illustrates why preserving these gaps matters. To make progress, the study adopted explicit provisional rules: Oracle cursor-parse as the compilation check, a study-defined result-comparison policy, read-only admission, and an HTTP request boundary for latency. The latency profile timed the complete HTTP completion request but excluded model startup, precomputed tokenization, warm-up, and Oracle execution. It measured five complete passes over the 100-question production workload and obtained an all-500 nearest-rank p90 of 16.156 seconds. The delivery report did not present this operational choice as a resolved customer requirement: it reported the measured result under the operator-defined boundary while continuing to mark the customer timing boundary as unresolved. The same distinction was retained for compilation semantics, result equivalence, serialization, tokenizer choice, and read-only policy.
paragraphs.zh: 后面的交付执行说明了为什么保留这些缺口很重要。 为了取得进展，该研究采用了明确的临时规则：以 Oracle 游标解析作为编译检查，采用研究自定义的结果比对策略、只读准入，以及以 HTTP 请求边界作为时延边界。 该时延统计对完整的 HTTP 补全请求计时，但不包括模型启动、预计算的词元化、预热以及 Oracle 执行。 它对 100 道题的生产工作负载进行了五次完整测量，得到了全部 500 条数据基于最近秩法的 p90 为 16.156 秒。 交付报告并未将这一运行层面的选择呈现为已解决的客户需求：它报告了在运维方定义的边界下测得的结果，同时继续将客户计时边界标记为未解决。 同样的区分也被保留用于编译语义、结果等价性、序列化、分词器选择以及只读策略。

paragraphs.en: Our delivery agent implements decoupled and autonomous settings. Each condition reads its requirements from the finalized discovery handoff of the corresponding extreme-ambiguity trajectory: the submitted acceptance criteria, the customer’s open decisions, and the readback corrections, normalized and injected into the planner and executor prompts as the primary requirements. Each condition also receives the released artifact grants and resource constraints. Discovery annotations and private simulator/judge traces are not delivery inputs. A versioned manifest pins the source workspace inventories. Preparation verifies those inventories, preserves the released evidence, and creates a fresh workspace; preparation alone does not launch planning, training, database evaluation, or profiling. The selected plans retain their own provenance and research settings; the current planner’s default configuration must not be substituted for the configuration that produced a frozen plan.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的交付智能体实现了去耦和自主的设置。 每个条件都从对应极端歧义轨迹的最终发现交接中读取其需求：提交的验收标准、客户待定的决策，以及回读更正，这些内容经规范化后作为主要需求注入规划器和执行器的提示中。 每个条件还接收已发布的工件授权和资源约束。 发现标注和私有的模拟器/评审员轨迹不作为交付的输入。 版本化的清单固定了源工作空间的清单记录。 准备阶段会验证这些清单记录、保留已发布的证据并创建一个全新的工作空间；仅准备阶段本身不会启动规划、训练、数据库评估或剖析。 被选中的计划保留其自身的来源和研究设置；当前规划器的默认配置不得替代生成该冻结计划时所使用的配置。

paragraphs.en: An OpenCode-based planner uses a controlled tool interface to inspect granted artifacts and produce a structured experiment plan. Its planning interface permits evidence inspection, draft construction, validation, and submission; it does not permit shell execution, model training, SQL execution, or performance measurement. The completed plans selected for delivery agent used static research inputs. The planning implementation also supports controlled live literature tools for new runs, but that capability does not imply that the selected plans used them. This setting uses the OpenCode planning baseline rather than the earlier thin action-loop planner.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 OpenCode 的规划器使用受控工具接口来检查已授权的工件，并生成结构化的实验计划。 其规划接口允许检查证据、构建草稿、验证和提交；不允许执行 shell、训练模型、执行 SQL 或测量性能。 为交付智能体选定的已完成计划使用了静态研究输入。 该规划实现还支持为新运行使用受控的实时文献工具，但这并不意味着选定的计划使用了这些工具。 本设置使用 OpenCode 规划基线，而不是早期的轻量动作循环规划器。

paragraphs.en: The accepted plan is frozen before a fresh OpenCode execution session begins. The executor implements the plan, resolves prerequisites, and records repairs, deviations, and measured outcomes. Frozen training choices remain the starting prescription; bounded implementation changes must be documented so their effect on interpretation can be assessed. Planning and execution are separate sessions, and the executor does not inherit an earlier session’s implementation or results.

paragraphs.en: Each condition has one NVIDIA A100 with 80 GB of GPU memory and a single cumulative deadline of 43,199 seconds (strictly under 12 hours) to produce a checkpoint. The budget includes allocation setup, model loading, pilots, failed attempts, all training trials and resumes, rollouts, in-training evaluation, and checkpoint writes; it does not reset between trials. Because the allocation contains one GPU, the corresponding maximum is just under 12 GPU-hours. Eligible checkpoints are the pinned revisions of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and mistralai/Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512-BF16 , to ensure fair comparison with the human FDE delivered model. Decoupled executions follow their frozen plan’s selection; autonomous agents choose and justify their selection within the same eligibility constraints. A budget is a ceiling, not a requirement to use the full allocation.

paragraphs.en: Profiling follows checkpoint export on a separate allocation with 96 CPU cores, 32 GiB RAM, zero GPUs, and exactly one profiling thread. The delivery agent execution policy permits dual AMD EPYC 9J14 or dual AMD EPYC 9J45 systems. Executors must verify actual allocation and instruction support, record the observed hardware, and use matched hardware for before/after comparisons; the two CPU models are not assumed to have identical performance. paragraphs.en: Training resources include 8,644 Spider examples, 9,055 BIRD examples, and 8,039 optional SParC turns. paragraphs.en: Execution and evaluation failures across repeated runs. We ran three independent runs per GPT-6.1 Sol delivery workflow using OpenCode (Table 11 ); run 3 of each workflow is the one reported in Table 2 . In the autonomous workflow, run 1 completed training but exceeded the compilation-failure threshold, run 2 could not retrieve database credentials and never reached evaluation, and run 3 passed all targets. In the decoupled workflow, run 1 was blocked on missing Hugging Face credentials; run 2 hit the agent’s continuation limit before training; and run 3 completed training but missed the SPIDER and BIRD accuracy acceptance criteria. Three of six runs delivered a fine-tuned model and only one met all acceptance. These outcomes distinguish execution failures from unmet acceptance criteria: delivering a model does not imply acceptance, and the two delivered-but-failed runs missed different targets.
paragraphs.zh: 多次重复运行中的执行与评估失败。 我们针对每个 GPT-6.1 Sol 交付工作流使用 OpenCode 运行了三次独立运行（表 11）；每个工作流的 run 3 即表 2 中报告的那次运行。 在自主工作流中，run 1 完成了训练但超出了编译失败阈值，run 2 无法检索数据库凭据且从未进入评估，run 3 通过了全部目标。 在解耦工作流中，run 1 因缺少 Hugging Face 凭据而被阻塞；run 2 在训练前触及了智能体的续跑上限；run 3 完成了训练但未达到 SPIDER 和 BIRD 准确率验收标准。 六次运行中有三次交付了微调后的模型，但只有一次满足全部验收标准。 这些结果区分了执行失败与未达验收标准：交付模型并不意味着通过验收，而且两次已交付但失败（delivered-but-failed）的运行未达标的目标各不相同。

paragraphs.en: Failure analysis. This is a cross-layer constraint-handling failure, not evidence that BIRD inference required unavailable hardware. The written instructions explicitly exempt CPU profiling but do not explicitly grant a separate final GPU-inference budget. The operational wrapper enforces a blanket GPU deadline, and the executor fails to preserve the distinction between training-time evaluation and final reporting. A clearer contract should freeze training and model selection within the original budget, then account for final evaluation separately, without permitting further training or tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 失败分析。 这是一个跨层的约束处理失败，而不是证明 BIRD 推理需要不可用的硬件。 书面指令明确豁免了 CPU 分析，但没有明确批准单独的最终 GPU 推理预算。 运维封装层强制执行统一的 GPU 截止时间，而执行器未能保留训练时评估与最终报告之间的区别。 更清晰的契约应当在原始预算内冻结训练和模型选择，然后单独核算最终评估，不允许进一步的训练或调优。
